subject: Flex commit & platform-fee amortization proposal for MediCore
content:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medicore.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: MediCore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment pricing — looking for flexible commit options

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to follow up with a concrete ask on commercial packaging so we can move from evaluation to procurement. High level: MediCore is open to a committed path but needs flexibility on duration and a meaningful reduction to the platform fee (the platform fee is a big line item for our capital plan).

Attached is our redlined SOW (MediCore_SOW_draft_v2.pdf) and an initial cost worksheet. Our preferred options to evaluate: 12-month vs 24-month commits, and a model where the platform fee is amortized against usage rather than billed upfront. Also: clear exit and data-handling terms in case of decommission.

Can Redwood share a packaging proposal that:
- Shows platform fee amortization across 12 and 24 months
- Lays out support tiers and on-call SLAs/costs
- Describes any one-time migration or onboarding credits

Would appreciate a response this week — procurement has a 9/24 committee.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Procurement, MediCore Health
Attachments: MediCore_SOW_draft_v2.pdf

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medicore.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — looking for flexible commit options

Alyssa —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attached SOW. We can be pragmatic here. Initial proposal (high level):

1) Flexible commit & amortization
- 12-month commit: platform fee amortized monthly across the term; 10% reduction to list platform fee if invoiced annually in advance.
- 24-month commit: platform fee amortized; 18% reduction to list platform fee and up to 10% additional credits applied if utilization thresholds are met in months 6 and 12.

2) Support tiers
- Standard: business-hours support, 24-hour P1 response target (included).
- Premium: 24/7 on-call, 4-hour P1 response target, proactive quarterly reviews (adds 15% to platform fee or can be purchased as a block of incidents).

3) Migration & onboarding credits
- One-time onboarding credit for customers who sign within 30 days of proposal: equivalent to one month of platform fee (applied as credit).

We have a simple amortization workbook (see attached) so you can see monthly cashflow impact under both terms. I can tighten the legal language around exit rights and data handling with David on legal.

Proposed next step: 30-minute pricing call tomorrow to run the workbook together and lock to a preferred term. What time works for you?

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference
Attachments: platform_fee_amortization_model.xlsx

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — looking for flexible commit options

Team — forwarding MediCore's ask. Key negotiation points: platform fee concessions, amortization mechanics, exit language. Thoughts on: how far to push on percent reduction for 24m? Also: are we comfortable with utilization-based credits (and how tight should thresholds be)?

Alyssa asked to get this to procurement committee by 9/24. Hoping Vanessa to own commercial counter, Monica on deployment/engineering constraints, David on legal exit/data clauses.

Thanks,
Rishi

-----
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — looking for flexible commit options

Rishi —

Good framing. My suggested commercial counter to start with (we can tighten in the pricing call):
- 12m: amortize platform fee monthly; 8% reduction if billed annually in advance. No credits tied to utilization.
- 24m: amortize platform fee monthly; 20% reduction to list platform fee with up to 5% of additional credits tied to meeting 70% utilization of committed nodes for two consecutive quarters (we will define nodes/metrics in SOW).
- Offer one-month onboarding credit for both terms to accelerate sign.
- Premium support upcharge should be explicit per-seat or per-node, not a flat percent; keep it optional.

Legal: David, we should avoid open-ended exit rights. Recommend a defined decommission window (90 days) with standard export support; limit any data retention liability to log/audit evidence. Also, require a performance clause: if P99 latency breach >3 incidents in rolling quarter, customer can request remediation credits (not immediate termination).

Operational: Monica, confirm whether 70% utilization threshold is feasible to measure and whether we need telemetry instrumentation changes.

V.

-----
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 13:09:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — looking for flexible commit options

Agree with Vanessa. A few legal bullets to include in the counter:
- Define "amortized platform fee" wording to clarify invoicing cadence and tax handling.
- Exit: 90-day decommission with export assistance; fees capped for export labor beyond the first 40 hours.
- Credits: cap for availability/perf credits to a % of quarterly platform fee (e.g., max 25% per quarter).
- Confidentiality: we should include a narrow carve-out that allows Redwood to publish anonymized benchmark performance for public marketing unless customer opts out in writing.

If we accept utilization credits, keep thresholds objective and telemetry-based. No subjective breach triggers.

—David

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@medicore.com>, MediCore Procurement <procurement@medicore.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2026 09:47:00 -0400
Subject: Updated commercial proposal: amortized platform fee and options

Alyssa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is a concise term sheet (redwood-private-pricing-term-sheet.docx) and the amortization workbook updated per Vanessa's suggested counter. Summary of our offer:

- 12-month commit: platform fee amortized monthly; 8% reduction to list platform fee if billed annually. One-month onboarding credit applied at signing. Standard support included.

- 24-month commit: platform fee amortized monthly; 20% reduction to list platform fee. Up to 5% additional utilization credits tied to objective telemetry thresholds (70% committed-node utilization for two consecutive quarters). One-month onboarding credit applies.

- Premium support: quoted separately per-node (see term sheet).

- Legal & exit: 90-day decommission window with export assistance; export labor beyond 40 hours billed at standard SOW rates. Performance credits capped at 25% of quarterly platform fee.

Next steps: I can join procurement committee on 9/24 at 10:00 AM ET for a short walk-through of the workbook and term sheet. Please confirm if that works; otherwise share preferred time and we’ll adjust.

Thanks and talk soon,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-private-pricing-term-sheet.docx, platform_fee_amortization_model.xlsx
